limitations: Current validation cannot prove provenance of a structurally valid foreign WAL accepted by SQLite. Such a WAL may alter business state while integrity/FK/migration checks remain valid.
现有校验不能证明合法外来WAL的来源身份；结构检查通过时业务状态仍可能改变。
staging/final mutations are rejected by SHA first; do not claim every deeper validator ran at that stage.
No real power loss, disk, SSD controller, filesystem damage or unreadable-media guarantee.
